class MinCost {
* * Write a function to find the minimum cost path to reach (m, n) from (0, 0) for the given cost matrix cost[][] and a position (m, n) in cost[][].
*
* > minCost([[1, 2, 3], [4, 8, 2], [1, 5, 3]], 2, 2)
* 8
* > minCost([[2, 3, 4], [5, 9, 3], [2, 6, 4]], 2, 2)
* 12
* > minCost([[3, 4, 5], [6, 10, 4], [3, 7, 5]], 2, 2)
* 16
java_code:
class MinCost
  [public static]
  minCost(cost: List<List<int>>, m: int, n: int): int
    T: int[][] := new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    for (i: int := 0; i < m + 1; i++)
      for (j: int := 0; j < n + 1; j++)
        if (i == 0 && j == 0)
          T[i][j] := cost.get(i).get(j)
        else
          if (i == 0)
            T[i][j] := T[i][j - 1] + cost.get(i).get(j)
          else
            if (j == 0)
              T[i][j] := T[i - 1][j] + cost.get(i).get(j)
            else
              T[i][j] := Math.min(T[i - 1][j - 1], Math.min(T[i - 1][j], T[i][j - 1])) + cost.get(i).get(j)
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end for
    end for;
    return T[m][n]
  end method
end class

    end if
